subject: SOC 2 exception log and artifact curation - Helio Ventures
raw_messages:
From: Helio Ventures Audit Team <audit@helio-ventures.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@helio-ventures.com
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 exceptions and artifact request - Helio Ventures

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of Helio's final assurance review, our external auditor (Sophia Klein) needs a consolidated exception/deviation log for Redwood's SOC 2 scope plus representative artifacts that substantiate compensating controls. Specifically we need:

- A CSV or spreadsheet listing all SOC 2 control exceptions or documented deviations between 2025-01-01 and present, with columns for control ID, exception description, owner, mitigation, and status.
- Proof-of-change artifacts for KMS key rotation and key custody (audit records, rotation timestamps).
- Representative audit trail snippets for cluster-level auth (k8s) spanning at least one month.
- A short cover letter describing how deviations were handled and what compensating controls were applied.

Requested delivery: end-of-day Friday, 2026-11-06 (Helio is on a compressed review window). If you foresee any issue with that timeline, please let me know immediately. Also, we need the artifacts with user identifiers redacted where personally identifiable information is present.

Thanks,
Helio Audit Team

---
Sophia Klein (on behalf of Helio Ventures Audit Team)
Senior IT Auditor
sophia.klein@helio-ventures.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Helio Ventures Audit Team <audit@helio-ventures.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 exceptions and artifact request - Helio Ventures

Hi Sophia / Helio team,

Appreciate the clear ask — we can provide a consolidated deviation log plus the artifacts you listed. High-level plan: I'll own the package assembly and cover letter; Karthik will coordinate legal/procurement signoff for any disclosure-related exceptions; Jonas will pull runtime audit snippets and validate redaction.

To manage delivery, we're going to bundle: 1) deviation CSV (machine-readable), 2) control-mapping appendix (PDF) that ties each row to the control statements, 3) a zip of raw artifacts (rotation proof, audit extracts) with README, and 4) a one-page cover letter.

A couple of clarifying Qs for your team:
- Do you need full raw logs or are extracts (time-windowed, hashed identifiers) acceptable?
- For the KMS rotation proofs, do you prefer HSM/KMS console export or the internal rotation audit that shows commit hashes and timestamps?

I'll create a shared Drive folder and post the hubspot ticket id once the package starts to land. Target: initial package by EOD 2026-11-05 Pacific, final redacted package by EOD 2026-11-06.

Marissa
Director, Security & Assurance
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 exceptions and artifact request - Helio Ventures

Marissa — this is doable but two operational items: legal needs to review the deviation disclosures (we have two incidents that were classed as "documented exceptions" and require redaction/approval), and procurement wants a short note on whether sharing these artifacts extends our standard data retention terms.

Action items I suggest we include in the package: a short cover letter (Marissa), the deviation CSV (truth table), and a separate legal clearance stamp (scanned approval). Also ask Helio which redaction standard they need (last 4 only, pseudonymization, or full redaction).

I'll ping Legal and Procurement now — assigning the clearance flag. If we need extra time to secure sign-off, we should let them know by EOD today.

Karthik
VP Sales — Enterprise Accounts
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, Helio Ventures Audit Team <audit@helio-ventures.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 13:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 exceptions and artifact request - Helio Ventures

Thanks — quick update and owners so we can hit the EOD target: 

- Marissa: assemble deviation CSV and write cover letter (deliverable: soc2_deviation_log_20261104.csv, cover_letter-soc2-package.pdf) — due 2026-11-05 17:00 PST.
- Jonas: extract k8s audit trail snippets and provide a dated index (deliverable: k8s_audit_excerpt_20260921.txt; include redaction notes) — due 2026-11-05 12:00 PST.
- Infrastructure team (cc'd via Jonas): prepare KMS rotation proof (deliverable: kms_rotation_proof_202608.zip) — target 2026-11-05 15:00 PST.
- Legal (assigned by Karthik): provide scanned clearance note for the two exceptions (deliverable: legal_clearance_exceptions.pdf) — due 2026-11-05 17:00 PST.

Attachments we plan to include in the initial package: soc2_deviation_log_20261104.csv, ctl-mapping-appendix.pdf, k8s_audit_excerpt_20260921.txt, kms_rotation_proof_202608.zip, cover_letter-soc2-package.pdf. We will not include full user-identifiable logs in the bundle — extracts only, redacted per Helio's preference.

Link to temporary shared folder: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/Helio-2026/SOC2-package (will populate as files arrive). HubSpot ticket: HLV-4521 (tracking).

If Helio confirms "hashed identifiers acceptable" we will proceed with pseudonymized extracts; if they require fully redacted PII, there may be a slight delay while we apply the redaction pipeline.

—Marissa
